text:
maria: Heads-up — March invoices for BetaApps (cust_id 4321) are weird. INV-202603-4321 shows reserved capacity credit applied twice (-$2,400 x2) and a second invoice INV-202603-4321-RETRY with $0 total was also generated. Net shows -$2,400 on account. @lena any idea? :eyes:
ajay: Can you paste the invoice IDs + s3 paths?
maria: INV-202603-4321
INV-202603-4321-RETRY
s3://billing-prod/invoices/2026/03/INV-202603-4321.json
s3://billing-prod/invoices/2026/03/INV-202603-4321-RETRY.json
I grabbed the logs — billing-pipeline returned 200 then a retry job created an empty invoice.
lena: On it. Running quick reconcile query now.
lena: ```sql
SELECT invoice_id, line_type, SUM(amount) AS total
FROM invoice_line_items
WHERE invoice_id IN ('INV-202603-4321','INV-202603-4321-RETRY')
GROUP BY invoice_id, line_type;
```
billing-bot: billing-pipeline: job invoice-generator-202603-03 finished with warnings: duplicate_line_items_detected; created 1 empty invoice (id=INV-202603-4321-RETRY).
ajay: Looks like idempotency key generation uses batch_id + customer_id; if retry uses different batch_id it's treated as a new invoice. Might be related to the batching refactor from last week.
lena: Found root cause: batcher now includes `segment_hash` in idempotency key which changed between the first run and retry — so retry produced a new invoice instead of being deduped. Patch ready to revert the change.
lena: Short-term recommended actions: 1) delete the empty retry invoice and void its DB record, 2) apply a manual reversal for the duplicated reserved-capacity credit, 3) re-run consolidation for cust_id 4321 to ensure ledger balances.
samir: I approve the manual reversal up to $5,000. Please include audit note and ticket link. :+1:
maria: I'll open a ticket and prepare the credit memo. Who can perform the S3 delete + DB void? @eng-infra?
eng-infra: I can do the S3 delete and mark the invoice void in the billing DB, but audit needs a signed approval in the ticket. @samir can you reply to the ticket to record approval? I'll then run the void script (safe-delete) and leave an entry in change log.
samir: Confirming approval in-thread — please run the void and attach the DB diff to FIN ticket.
maria: Created ticket FIN-2026-031: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-2026-031. Steps in the ticket: S3 delete, DB void, create manual credit memo for -$2,400, re-run consolidation, verify ledger.
ajay: Quick note for postmortem: check the batching refactor PR 421; idempotency key tests didn't cover retries with different segment_hash. I'll add a test.
lena: Deploy hotfix (revert idempotency change) planned in ~2h. Will post deploy notice here.
maria: Finance to confirm ledger after reversal. I'll draft the postmortem once we have confirmation. Thanks all. :white_check_mark; closing loop for now.
